Delhi court orders FIR probe against Sonia Gandhi over voter list entry

A Delhi court has set aside a previous order that had refused to register a First Information Report (FIR) against Sonia Gandhi concerning allegations of forgery in her voter list inclusion. The court's decision mandates a probe into the matter.
